title: Employee Attrition Analysis
findings: Accommodation and food services has the highest listed quits rate at 3.5%.
Federal government has the lowest listed rate at 0.5%.
Retail trade increased +0.6 percentage points from August 2025 to August 2026.
action: Compare an organization’s own monthly voluntary quits with the closest industry benchmark and investigate differences using confidential aggregate employee feedback.
problem: How do U.S. voluntary separation rates vary by industry, and where should an employer benchmark retention?
grain: One published industry-level, seasonally adjusted quits-rate comparison for August 2025 and August 2026. The 2026 estimates were preliminary when published.
definitions: Monthly quits rate = number of quits during the month ÷ employment × 100, as defined by BLS.
Quits are generally voluntary separations and exclude retirements and transfers to other locations.
Year-over-year change is August 2026 rate minus August 2025 rate, in percentage points.
These are monthly, seasonally adjusted survey estimates, not annual employee turnover rates.
caveats: This is a small manually transcribed extract of a BLS table, not individual-level employee data. It cannot identify reasons for leaving, employee characteristics or causal factors. The latest month was preliminary at publication; estimates can be revised and survey uncertainty matters. Industry comparisons do not control for workforce composition.
nextsteps: Align the organization’s quits definition, month and denominator with the BLS definition.
Compare against the closest industry over a longer series, accounting for sample uncertainty.
Use aggregated exit feedback and a voluntary intervention to test actionable hypotheses.
quality: 19 transcribed table rows, including one all-industry total; source values are seasonally adjusted rates. All 19 rows have both published comparison values. The total is excluded from the industry ranking.
citation: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, The Economics Daily, “Quits rate 3.5 percent in accommodation and food services, August 2026,” 13 October 2026.
